cobblemon.move.aguagatcha.desc: User heals based on damage dealt, hits both opponents, and has a 50% chance to confuse..
cobblemon.move.mightyslash.desc: The user slashes the oppenent with its razor sharp claws.
cobblemon.move.abduct.desc: The user blasts out a ball of steel and iron, when the move lands it scatters steel spikes all over the opposing side of the battlefield.
cobblemon.move.electrodrain.desc: User heals based on damage dealt, hits both opponents, and has a 10% chance to paralyze.
cobblemon.move.quickshot.desc: Fails if the target did not select a physical attack, special attack, or Me First for use this turn, or if the target moves before the user.
cobblemon.move.sombersong.desc: The user changes up their musical style and gets a fancy new form with it! Has a 10% chance to paralyze.
cobblemon.ability.fleeingfelon.desc: Prevents damage from pivoting moves, when an opponent uses a damaging pivoting move on the user they will not do damage and will take 40 damage.
cobblemon.ability.zoomy.desc: Special moves at or below 60 base power have +1 priority.
cobblemon.ability.sunscreen.desc: Prevents the Pokémon from getting a burn. It will also gradually regain HP in sun. In sun the user will be immune to all status effects inflicted. (Idea by: Marshlands [pokengine.org/abilities/05d2lnqy/Sunscreen])
cobblemon.ability.fusionboost.desc: Raises highest stat in Snow, or if holding Booster Energy.
cobblemon.ability.burnboost.desc: The user does 1.5x damage if the opponent is burned.
cobblemon.ability.levetric.desc: In electric terrain the user will levitate off of the ground until the terrain ends and gain a 1.5 boost to Special Defense.
cobblemon.ability.rockout.desc: Doubles the chance of moves' secondary effects occurring.
cobblemon.ability.runiccurse.desc: Once per battle when switching in the user sets up trick room when not holding an item and gets a +1 atk and def boost. If sent out in trick room it will disable it then get a +1 atk and def boost. Status moves used by this pokemon in trick room will have -5 priority
cobblemon.ability.lavabubble.desc: Restores the Pokémon’s HP in rain or when it is hit by Water-type moves. Reduces HP in harsh sunlight, and increases the damage received from Fire-type moves..
cobblemon.ability.healpy.desc: The user copies whatever health recovery the opposing Pokemon undergo (includes abilities, items, and moves). The user must already be on the field for this ability to work, It will not activate if the user switches in on the opponent healing. If two pokemon with this ability are on the field at the same time they cancel each other out
cobblemon.species.typhlosion-mega.desc: When struck by a thunderbolt during a hurricane Typhlosion will unlock this new form. (Designed by: CarnekVT [ko-fi.com/s/4572632a5f])
cobblemon.species.kingler-mega.desc: This mega form was found by combining gigantimax with mega evolution.
cobblemon.species.lapras-mega.desc: This mega form was found by combining gigantimax with mega evolution.
cobblemon.species.charizard-mega.desc: This mega form was found by combining gigantimax with mega evolution.
cobblemon.species.snorlax-mega.desc: This mega form was found by combining gigantimax with mega evolution.
cobblemon.species.sandaconda-mega.desc: This mega form was found by combining gigantimax with mega evolution.
cobblemon.species.butterfree-mega.desc: This mega form was found by combining gigantimax with mega evolution.
cobblemon.species.toxtricity-mega.desc: This mega form was found by combining gigantimax with mega evolution.
cobblemon.species.dusknoir-mega.desc: When Dusknoir megas it gains a hunger for souls, if you encounter one it is wise not get too close.
cobblemon.species.machamp-mega.desc: Machamp's mega evolution can only be obtained from Machamp winning many battles and gaining an inflated ego.
item.desc.infinite_fusion_splicer_bfusio: Used to fuse Blaziken and Latias
item.desc.infinite_fusion_splicer_gfusio: Used to fuse Deoxys and Gardevoir
item.desc.infinite_fusion_splicer_afusio: Used to fuse Deoxys and Gardevoir
item.desc.charizarditez: Used to Mega Evolve Charizard into its Z form.
item.desc.toxtricitite: Used to Mega Evolve both forms of Toxtricity.
cobblemon.move.alluringvoice.desc: The user attacks the target using its angelic voice. This also confuses the target if its stats have been boosted during the turn.
cobblemon.move.temperflare.desc: Spurred by desperation, the user attacks the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's previous move failed.
cobblemon.move.supercellslam.desc: The user electrifies its body and drops onto the target to inflict damage. If this move misses, the user takes damage instead.
cobblemon.move.hardpress.desc: The target is crushed with an arm, a claw, or the like to inflict damage. The more HP the target has left, the greater the move's power.
cobblemon.move.upperhand.desc: The user reacts to the target's movement and strikes with the heel of its palm, making the target flinch. This move fails if the target is not readying a priority move.
cobblemon.move.psychicnoise.desc: The user attacks the target with unpleasant sound waves. For two turns, the target is prevented from recovering HP through moves, Abilities, or held items.
cobblemon.move.electroshot.desc: The user gathers electricity on the first turn, boosting its Sp. Atk stat, then fires a high-voltage shot on the next turn. The shot will be fired immediately in rain.
cobblemon.move.syrupbomb.desc: The user sets off an explosion of sticky candy syrup, which coats the target and causes the target's Speed stat to drop each turn for three turns.
cobblemon.move.zdragondance.desc: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that resets all lowered stats and raises its Attack and Speed stats.
cobblemon.move.bloodmoon.desc: The user unleashes the full brunt of its spirit from a full moon that shines as red as blood. This move can't be used twice in a row.
cobblemon.move.hydrosteam.desc: The user blasts the target with boiling-hot water. This move's power is not lowered in harsh sunlight but rather boosted by 50 percent.
cobblemon.move.psyblade.desc: The user rends the target with an ethereal blade. This move's power is boosted by 50 percent if the user is on Electric Terrain.
cobblemon.move.matchagotcha.desc: The user fires a blast of tea that it mixed. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.
cobblemon.move.ivycudgel.desc: The user strikes with an ivy-wrapped cudgel. This move's type changes depending on the mask worn by the user, and it has a heightened chance of landing a critcal hit.
cobblemon.move.ficklebeam.desc: The user shoots a beam of light to inflict damage. Sometimes all the user's heads shoot beams in unison, doubling the moves's power.
cobblemon.move.burningbulwark.desc: The user's intensely hot fur protects it from attacks and also burns any attacker that makes direct contact with it.
cobblemon.move.thunderclap.desc: This move enables the user to attack first with a jolt of electricity. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.
cobblemon.move.mightycleave.desc: The user wields the light that has accumulated atop its head to cleave the target. This move hits even if the target protects itself.
cobblemon.move.tachyoncutter.desc: The user attacks by launching particle blades at the target twice in a row. This attack never misses.
cobblemon.move.terastarstorm.desc: With the power of its crystals, the user bombards and elimnates the target. When used by Terapagos in its Stellar Form, this move damages all opposing Pokémon.
cobblemon.move.dragoncheer.desc: The user raises its allies’ morale with a draconic cry so that their future attacks have a heightened chance of landing critical hits. This rouses Dragon types more.
cobblemon.move.gmaxdrumsolo.desc: A Grass-type attack that Gigantamax Rillaboom use. This move can be used on the target regardless of its Abilities.
cobblemon.move.paleowave.desc: Has a 20% chance to lower the target's Attack one stage.
cobblemon.move.shadowstrike.desc: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.
